test_title: PYST 3: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"Too much official formality."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Red tape**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"Red tape"** refers to excessive official formality or rigid adherence to bureaucratic rules and procedures, which often causes unnecessary delays. (अत्यधिक औपचारिकता)
 
 
• **Example:** The project was delayed for months because of the red tape involved in getting government approval.
 
 
• Red tape is commonly used to describe situations where too many regulations hinder progress or efficiency. (अत्यधिक नियमों के कारण प्रगति में बाधा)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Red tape**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bureaucracy **(नौकरशाही): A system of administration characterized by strict rules, hierarchy, and official procedures. 
 
 
• **Example:** The bureaucracy in the organization made decision-making a slow process.
 
 

 
• **Etiquette **(शिष्टाचार): The customary code of polite behavior in society or among members of a particular group.
 
 
• **Example:** Good table etiquette is essential during formal dinners.
 
 

 
• **Discipline** (अनुशासन): The practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behavior, using punishment to correct disobedience.
 
 
• **Example:** Discipline is necessary for success in both personal and professional life.
